meta.copy: docs/issues.md, 'The interface doesn't say what to do'

tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: The table the ideas lie on: the Spill board, Shape's sections and tray, Draft's outline margin. Cards and pages sit on it.

tokens.name: desk-2
tokens.usage: A group's tray on the desk: the recessed area that holds one point and the ideas under it.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Writing surfaces and panels: the spill page, the draft page, the idea sheet, the top bar, hosted pages.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Anything you can move or pick: idea cards, menus, inputs, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders at rest, dividers between sections and panels.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered card borders, section breaks in the draft, disabled button outlines. Decorative only (1.6:1).

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The border of an input or secondary button: 3.7:1 on page, 3.2:1 on desk, 3.8:1 on card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The writer's words and every control label. 16:1 on page, 14:1 on desk. Also the primary button fill and the selected-card ring.

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: quiet buttons, field labels, stage names not yet current. 7.4:1 on page, 6.5:1 on desk.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Meta: counts, times, type tags for plain types. 6.2:1 on page, 5.4:1 on desk, 4.9:1 on desk-2, 5.1:1 on marker.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (primary button, current stage). 16:1.

tokens.name: thread
tokens.usage: The fat line on the welcome page: the tangle and the thread that comes out of it. 17.9:1 on page.

tokens.name: pencil
tokens.usage: Blue pencil: Scratch talking to you. Guidance in empty spaces, where a drop will land, the section you are writing in, keyboard focus. Never on your ideas or their labels. 6.3:1 on page, 5.5:1 on desk, 5.6:1 on pencil-soft.

tokens.name: pencil-soft
tokens.usage: Blue-pencil wash: the current outline section, the empty-state animation, an info notice.

tokens.name: pencil-line
tokens.usage: Outlines Scratch draws for you: ghost cards, the empty-state cells. 3:1 or more on desk, page and card.

tokens.name: question
tokens.usage: Questions: tag text and mark. 5.9:1 on page, 5.2:1 on desk. Also low credits.

tokens.name: question-soft
tokens.usage: Behind a low credits meter.

tokens.name: objection
tokens.usage: Objections, errors and a required section left empty. 6.4:1 on page, 5.6:1 on desk.

tokens.name: objection-soft
tokens.usage: Behind an error notice and the out-of-credits meter.

tokens.name: go
tokens.usage: Where a drop will land, and an idea you have written about (crossed off). 6.1:1 on page, 5.3:1 on desk.

tokens.name: go-soft
tokens.usage: A level under a drag.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: Highlighter: an idea in the outline and the words that use it, lit together on hover.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Hover behind quiet buttons, icon buttons and menu items.

tokens.name: type-claim
tokens.usage: Claims: the points everything else groups under.

tokens.name: type-evidence
tokens.usage: Evidence.

tokens.name: type-story
tokens.usage: Stories.

tokens.name: type-question
tokens.usage: Questions: one of two types with their own colour.

tokens.name: type-objection
tokens.usage: Objections: the other type with its own colour.

tokens.name: type-concept
tokens.usage: Concepts.

tokens.name: type-coinage
tokens.usage: Coinages.

tokens.name: type-artifact
tokens.usage: Artifacts: a figure, code block or demo described now, built later.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ring 2px out on every control.

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: The lead sentence under the welcome page's animation.

styles.name: text-page
styles.usage: The draft page, at the 680px measure.
styles.sample: The blades in the hot section sit in gas hotter than the metal can survive.

styles.name: text-spill
styles.sample: So how much of the engine's work goes into keeping itself from melting?

styles.name: text-title
styles.usage: The document's title in the top bar: it is the writer's, so it is serif.

styles.name: text-quote
styles.usage: Your words in the idea sheet, behind a rule.
styles.sample: What keeps them alive is air.

styles.name: text-words
styles.usage: Your words on a card, three lines at most.
styles.sample: pushed out through tiny holes so it lays a film over the surface

styles.name: text-heading
styles.usage: The idea sheet's label; section heads on hosted pages.

styles.name: text-head-label
styles.usage: The label on a group's head card.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Card labels, level and section names, notice titles.

styles.name: text-ui
styles.usage: Everything else Scratch says: menus, fields, notices.

styles.name: text-small
styles.usage: Meta and help: counts in words, field help, tooltips.

styles.name: text-tag
styles.usage: Type tags and section markers, in capitals.

styles.name: text-hint
styles.usage: Guidance in an empty space, in blue pencil. It goes when the space fills.
styles.sample: Your ideas land here as cards, grouped under the point they support.

styles.name: text-hero
styles.usage: The one headline on the welcome page, unmasked as you scroll. Two short lines.

styles.name: text-count
styles.usage: Counts: the +N on a folded group.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a tag; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in a button; between cards in a column.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding (horizontal); gaps between cards in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on small panels; gutters between groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Top-bar side padding; sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding; the gap between a page and its controls.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections of a sheet or the account page.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Draft page side padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above a page title.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Around the welcome page's blocks.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Idea chips in the draft, key hints.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Idea cards and drop slots: a little softer than paper, still a card.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Group trays, notices, the sign-in card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Stage steps, the cuts meter.

shadow.note: Shadows mean 'you can pick this up'. Only cards, menus and a card in your hand have one.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: An idea card at rest: just enough lift to say it can be picked up.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A hovered card; menus and tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-drag
tokens.usage: A card in your hand, with a 2° tilt.

size.note: Fixed sizes the layouts depend on.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Button and input height.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, icon buttons, segmented options.

tokens.name: size-topbar
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: width-spill
tokens.usage: The spill page column.

tokens.name: width-outline
tokens.usage: Draft's outline column.

tokens.name: width-sheet
tokens.usage: The idea sheet.

tokens.name: width-card
tokens.usage: An idea card on the board.

tokens.name: width-group
tokens.usage: A group tray on the board.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: The draft's line length.
